{{Quote|They took out an entire security detail and scuttled one of our new starships.|Hera Syndulla|<ref name="Part One" />}}
The '''''Vesper'''''<ref name="Part One Highlights">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-part-1-master-and-apprentice-highlights|text=''Ahsoka'' Analyzed: 5 Highlights from "Part One: Master and Apprentice"}}</ref> was a [[Defender-class cruiser|''Defender''-class cruiser]] in service of the [[New Republic]]. Under the command of [[Captain]] [[Hayle]], the ''Vesper'' was tasked with transporting the [[prisoner]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] and rendezvousing with ''[[Home One]]''. However, the cruiser was [[Attack on the Vesper|intercepted]] by [[Baylan Skoll]] and his apprentice [[Shin Hati]]. The duo killed many on board, scuttling the ship and leaving with Elsbeth.<ref name="Part One" />
